Name: Out of Season Bonuses
Author: azureglasses
Description:
Have you ever stopped and thought, sigh, these villagers just don't respect the difficulty of getting them a spring crop in the wintertime? Well, sigh no longer! With Out of Season Bonuses, you get a bonus to the sell price and friendship of an item when sold/given as a gift out of its season(s). This includes crops, fish, and various other seasonal items. 

[size=4]Features[/size][list]
[*][size=2]Increases sell prices by 10% the season after item is in season, 15% two seasons after, and 20% three seasons after, as applicable[/size]
[*][size=2]Similarly increases friendship bonus by same percentages based on time since growth season[/size]
[/list][size=2]
[/size][size=4]Requirements[/size]
[url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]SMAPI[/url][size=2] 1.15 or above.
[/size]
[size=4]Installation[/size]
[size=2]Unzip the file to your Stardew Valley/Mods folder, then run Stardew Valley with SMAPI. It should run out of the box.[/size]

[size=4]Compatibility[/size]
[size=2]Should generally be compatible with any mod that doesn't affect crop prices, excepting a minor bug with UI mods that[/size][size=2] show item prices. You may notice discrepancies between chest item prices and inventory item prices if you install the mod on an existing game with that kind of UI mod. [/size][size=2]To fix this, put a stone in your fridge. The next day, all the chest items should be updated. (You can then take the stone out of the fridge.)
[/size]
[size=2]You can also just manually grab chest items then put them back, or wait until the first day of a new season to update the values.[/size]
